Name: NPC furniture - Krobus' Sewer Interior
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Furniture so your farmhouse can match the sewer interior and make Krobus feel more at home. Includes doorway that can warp you to the sewers.
Description:
_Description:_

*   Furniture and wallpaper conversion of the sewer tiles you can decorate your farmhouse with
_Quick start for main file:_

1.  Download this mod and it's requirements. For the DGA version you need [DGA](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365) and [AT](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246)

2.  Extract this mod and it's required mods into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [this guide](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started)﻿)

3.  Buy the furniture at Krobus' shop in the sewer

4.  Recolor furniture using AT bucket tool which can also be bought at Robin's Carpenter shop. There is a video [here on how to use AT](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9984) or [written instructions here](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246)﻿﻿.
_Mobile version_
I might make one but only after I know for sure the version I made for [bathroom furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10982)﻿ works. I don't have the mobile game so I'm making it compatible in theory but it'd be nice to have feedback on if it works and how easy it is to use.

_Compatibility_

*   Should be compatible with most mods

*   Don't remove DGA files without first trashing any DGA items you have placed in-game
_Tips and tricks_
Using the files:

*   The main download includes a DGA and an AT content pack, you can use both together or delete one. I wanted to just have DGA because then it adds all the furniture as independent objects and you can find them all easily in one shop or by typing "dga_store Asterisk.DGA.SewerFurniture" in your smapi console. However, DGA doesn't have all the features I want so an AT pack made more sense to have a full complete set of items to fully transform the farmhouse. But AT replaces furniture and it can be difficult to remember which furniture replaces what when you're playing. So I made both! Every item of furniture is in the AT folder, and then I converted what I could that works with DGA

*   To know which sewer texture replaces what vanilla item through AT check out the folders in the "[AT]/Textures"

*   For the beam recolour you can use my [beam recolour mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11597) and choose "sewer"﻿
Furniture with special properties:

*   The arch can be right clicked to take you to the sewer. There's a similar furniture item in [Magical Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10142) with a different design if you want a different look

*   The statue of uncertainly is also functional, as well as the windows and wall sconces

*   The rock is a 'rug' so you can place it on the crystal path but still walk over the top of it

*   I'm a big fan of using the AT crystal paths in the house

*   [Asters Big Interior Mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10400) - changes beams and kitchen
